task: Ground factual claims for the coding project bootstrap structure.
output_summary: A new coding-project-bootstrap tool, blueprint config, workflow, prompt, memory anchor, and history/spec records were added so future coding projects can be planned and created with technology-aware dry-run-first scaffolding.

evidence.reliability: Tracked Python CLI implementing list, plan, and create behavior.
Command output included a root target path, generated files, and a registry_entry.
Command output targeted a nested path and showed registry_entry null.
Tracked workflow, prompt, and router link.
Command output returned ready_to_bootstrap and included coding_project_bootstrap anchors.
Command output returned self_documenting for the blueprint config.

claims.statement: A reusable coding-project-bootstrap CLI was added under _tools.
verification_steps: Read the tool source and ran its unit tests.

claims.statement: The blueprint config defines 7 supported blueprints: generic, python-agent, python-cli, next-app, react-vite, spring-boot, and c-library.
verification_steps: Read blueprints.json and ran the list command.

claims.statement: The tool can produce a dry-run root project plan with a registry entry when --register is used.
verification_steps: Ran the root project plan command with --register.

claims.statement: The tool can produce a nested target plan without a registry entry.
verification_steps: Ran the nested target plan command.

claims.statement: The workflow, prompt router, and memory bootstrap were connected to the new bootstrap flow.
verification_steps: Checked workflow/prompt files and ran memory bootstrap check.

claims.statement: The new blueprint config is self-documenting and the full workspace-health check passed.
verification_steps: Ran config contract and workspace-health checks.

uncertainty_notes: Generated starter files are intentionally minimal. Real implementation still needs stack-specific coding research and installation review.
limitation_notes: No actual product project was created in this work.
